context: This criteria evaluates the correct usage of response streaming to handle large files without buffering.

checklist.name: Stream piping
checklist.description: Uses the .pipe() method to pipe the response to a writable stream (e.g., fs.createWriteStream)

checklist.name: Buffer disabling
checklist.description: Disables response buffering using .buffer(false) to enable true streaming

checklist.name: Stream events
checklist.description: Handles stream events such as 'end', 'data', or 'error' to manage the streaming process
